{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display the first few rows
display(sales_df.head())

# Display basic info
sales_df.info()

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()
display(missing_values)

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()
print(f'Duplicate rows: {duplicates}')

# Display unique values for key columns
print('\nUnique values in campaign column:')
display(sales_df['campaign'].unique())

print('\nUnique values in date column:')
display(sales_df['date'].unique()[:10])  # First 10 unique dates

# Check the dictionary for definitions
dict_df = pd.read_md('data/sales_dictionary.md')
display(dict_df)"}
